notes.title: DreadOut Remastered Collection Update: All Bonus Contents, Free!
notes.notes: [p]As a thank you for supporting DreadOut Remastered Collection, we’re releasing something special, and it’s completely [b]FREE[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]The DLC essentially contains all of DreadOut's past extra content. In details:[/p][h3][b]DreadOut: The Untolds Webcomic[/b] [/h3][p]12 high-resolution episodes revealing hidden fragments of Linda’s journey, revealing her untold stories of DreadOut.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Official DreadOut Manga[/b][/h3][p]100+ pages written and illustrated by Indonesian artists, expanding the haunting world of DreadOut.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Original Soundtrack and Background Music from DreadOut[/b] [/h3][p]Featuring Indonesian Indie Bands including Mocca, Koil, Sarasvati, Sigmun, Tesla Manaf, and more.[/p][p]Original OST by Adhitia Sulistiana Wibisana & Pratama Kusuma Putra, featuring Risa Saraswati.[/p][p]Available in both MP3 & WAV formats.[/p][p][/p][p]You’ll find your free DLC in your installation folder: "DLC - Manga Soundtrack". We hope you enjoy the full content of DreadOut Remastered, and thank you for supporting this universe.[/p][p][/p][p]With love, Digital Happiness[/p]

notes.title: DreadOut Remastered Collection Available Now
notes.notes:
[h1]We're celebrating our anniversary with DreadOut Remastered Collection release on PC![/h1]

[previewyoutube=mnADEwTvPj8;full][/previewyoutube]

Today is a special day for us at Digital Happiness. To celebrate our anniversary, we’re releasing DreadOut Remastered Collection on PC.

This collection brings together two classic horror titles in one package: DreadOut and DreadOut: Keepers of The Dark. Originally released between 2014 and 2016, both games have been remastered to provide a smoother, more immersive experience for today’s platforms.

Remastering the original games has always been difficult. The first DreadOut was made over a decade ago using Unity, and we’ve since moved to Unreal. For years, we struggled to make it happen. Most porting developers gave up. That changed when we met our publishing partner, Soft Source, and their porting team. They worked with care and dedication, [b]starting with consoles, and now we’re finally able to bring the remastered version to PC as well.[/b]

[h1]But why?[/h1]
[h2]Giving more options![/h2]
With this release, we want to offer more flexibility. If you only want one of the titles, the remastered versions of DreadOut and Keepers of The Dark are [b]still available separately[/b]. But for those who are new to the series or missed the original releases, we could say that this collection is a more convenient way to experience both games together in a single launcher.

[h1]What’s New in the Remastered Version?[/h1]
We’ve done more than just a visual upgrade. Here’s what’s different:

[h3]Key Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Launcher Scene: Start both games from a single interface.
[*] Improved Controls: Smoother, more consistent control system optimized for modern hardware.
[*] Enhanced Graphics: Added Ambient Occlusion, Motion Blur, Bloom, and SMAA.
[/list]

[h3]Visual Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Brightness System: Improved lighting using post-processing for better visual quality.
[*] Updated UI Elements: Main menu warning screen now covers the full screen for consistency.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay Enhancements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Camera Improvements: Better control responsiveness, fixed sensitivity issues, and smoother DSLR aiming.
[*] Animation Fixes: Analog movement now affects character animations properly.
[*] Virtual Drifting Fixed: Improved analog stick behavior for tighter character control.
[/list]

[h3]UI and Navigation[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gallery Rework: System tab replaced with a Gallery accessible via Start button, streamlining the menu.
[/list]

[h3]Enemy Behavior Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Koil Fight: Fixed NPCs getting stuck between death/respawn states.
[*] Mirror Entity Removed: Deactivated a scrapped mechanic involving Linda’s mirror.
[*] Water Ghost Behavior: Fixed teleporting bug in the water level ghost encounter.
[/list]

[h3]Now with More Languages[/h3]
We’ve also expanded our localization support. So more players around the world can experience the game in their native language. DreadOut Remastered Collection is now available in:
[list]
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Portuguese
[*] French
[/list]

***

This remaster has been a long journey. We’re proud of what we’ve accomplished and excited to finally bring it to you. Whether you’re returning to DreadOut or playing it for the first time, we hope you enjoy the experience.

We’re also working on Steam Deck optimization and are aiming for full verification in the near future.

Thank you for your continued support. Hope you enjoy every bit of it!

:DH
